rules.title: Recipe Viewer Conflict
rules.description: JEI, REI, and EMI all provide recipe viewing functionality. Having more than one can cause severe UI lag and keybind conflicts.
rules.recommendation: Keep only ONE: JEI is the most stable for Forge, EMI is the most modern.

rules.title: Shaders Engine Conflict
rules.description: Optifine and Oculus both try to manage Shaders. This will result in a crash or a black screen.
rules.recommendation: Remove Optifine. Oculus + Rubidium/Embeddium is much better for performance on 1.20.1.

rules.title: Rendering Pipeline Conflict
rules.description: Optifine is incompatible with modern performance mods like Rubidium/Embeddium.
rules.recommendation: Choose Rubidium for better FPS, or Optifine if you specifically need its unique features.

rules.title: Sodium Fork Conflict
rules.description: Rubidium and Embeddium are both forks of Sodium. They cannot run together.
rules.recommendation: Remove Rubidium. Embeddium is currently the most updated and compatible version.

rules.title: Multiple Maps Detected
rules.description: You have multiple map mods installed. This wastes RAM and clutters the screen.
rules.recommendation: Keep only JourneyMap OR the Xaero's suite (Minimap + World Map).

rules.title: Lithium Fork Conflict
rules.description: Canary and Radium are both ports of Lithium. Running both will cause logic conflicts.

rules.title: Lighting Engine Conflict
rules.recommendation: In 1.20.1, the base game lighting is already optimized. Starlight is often unnecessary or can cause issues with some shaders.

rules.title: Memory Optimization Conflict
rules.description: Some older 'BetterFPS' ports conflict with FerriteCore's memory management.
rules.recommendation: Keep FerriteCore; it is the industry standard for RAM reduction in 1.20.1.

rules.title: Create Addon Conflict
rules.description: Detected multiple Create addons that modify the same engine logic, often leading to Mixin crashes.
rules.recommendation: Check the logs for 'Mixin Transformation' errors and remove the offending addon.

rules.title: Loading Optimizer Conflict
rules.description: FastLoad and DashLoader both modify the world/resource loading sequence.
rules.recommendation: Remove DashLoader as it is known to break many Forge mods.

rules.title: Library Version Warning
rules.description: Alex's Mobs is extremely sensitive to the version of Citadel installed.
rules.recommendation: Update Citadel to the latest version available for 1.20.1.

rules.title: Mod Loader Bridge Conflict
rules.description: Multiple attempts to bridge Fabric mods to Forge detected.
rules.recommendation: Use only Sinytra Connector for 1.20.1 and ensure all dependencies are met.
